infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SkelClock records where you are when you clock on and off, so your hours can be matched to the right job.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you turn on auto-detect arrival, SkelClock checks your location in the background to clock you in or out when you reach a job site. This is off by default, you can turn it off anytime, and anything the phone isn't confident about still asks you to confirm before it counts.
